# Appliory

> Appliory (https://www.appliory.tech) is a privacy-first web platform offering free online document, PDF, and image utilities. All operations run 100% locally in the user's browser without file uploads or user registration.

## Leadership & Origins

- Founder & Lead Engineer: Ammar Hassan Malik (Pakistan)
- Related Studio: VIRELEO (https://vireleo.me)
- Contact Email: fitduo07@gmail.com
- Contact Phone / WhatsApp: +92 321 5772078
- Mission: Providing students, job applicants, and professionals with secure, client-side document preparation utilities that never transmit sensitive personal records to third-party servers.

## Core Tools & Capabilities

- Image Compressor (https://www.appliory.tech/tools/image-compressor): Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images to 20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, or custom target sizes in KB. 100% private, client-side canvas compression with live preview.
- Image Resizer (https://www.appliory.tech/tools/image-resizer): Resize photos to exact pixel dimensions (passport 600x600, ID photo 413x531, custom dimensions) with aspect ratio lock and format conversion.
- PDF Page Counter & Summary (https://www.appliory.tech/tools/pdf-page-counter): Count PDF pages and extract text summaries locally using PDF.js without uploading sensitive documents.
- File Size Checker (https://www.appliory.tech/tools/file-size-checker): Verify document sizes in KB and MB against official application portal upload limits.
- Duplicate File Finder (https://www.appliory.tech/tools/duplicate-file-finder): Identify exact duplicate files across your device using cryptographic SHA-256 byte hashing.
- Document Application Checker (https://www.appliory.tech/tool): Workspace to prepare and check scholarships, university admissions, and job application document packages against configurable checklist rules.

## Privacy & Security Guarantees

- Zero Server Uploads: Files never leave the user's device. Processing occurs purely inside browser memory via HTML5 Canvas, Web APIs, and client-side JavaScript.
- No Accounts Required: No signup, login, email gate, tracking, or document history retained.
- Complete Data Ownership: Processed files and downloaded reports remain entirely on the user's local machine. Closing or refreshing the tab clears all active memory.
